result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: duplicate restaurant cards, truncated names, and inconsistent overlapping of delivery-time badges on images.

issues.description: The first two items in 'Fastest near you' are identical duplicates (same Green Bowl Poké image, name, time, and delivery fee), which looks broken and wastes space.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel shows unique restaurants; fix any data or query bug that duplicates the same listing.

issues.description: The third restaurant name is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' with no ellipsis, making the title unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text overflow ellipsis (or allow two lines) so long names are clearly truncated rather than cut mid-word.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit inconsistently on the food images—some overlap the dish awkwardly while others sit cleaner—reducing visual polish.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge placement (e.g. bottom-left with consistent padding and contrast) so they don’t clash with the imagery.

issues.description: Category filter chips row ends abruptly with a partial empty chip on the right, looking unfinished even if horizontal scroll is intended.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade so the scrollable row doesn’t feel cut off mid-chip.
